paragraphs.en: When waking up from sleep, before washing hands, one should say:

paragraphs.he: מוֹדֶה (האשה אומרת: מוֹדָה) אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ:
paragraphs.en: I am thankful before You, living and enduring King, for you have mercifully restored my soul within me. Great is Your faithfulness.
